title: Compact control density & high-contrast cost tiles — keyboard & i18n audit
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Audit and prototype work to make compact control rows and cost tiles accessible and locale-ready across Console dashboards and rollout panels. Scope covers: (1) densified control rows (filters, granularity, rollout segment toggles) where reduced spacing risks keyboard discoverability; (2) a high-contrast variant for cost tiles and compact cards that meets WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast for text and UI controls at small sizes; (3) keyboard traversal order and focus rings for segmented micro-rollout controls and inline actions; (4) locale-aware numeric formatting and number truncation conventions for cost summaries (eg. short notation vs full number in different locales, decimal separators, non-breaking thin space for thousands where applicable); (5) reduced-motion and animation fallbacks for sparkline microcharts; (6) RTL layout validation for scrubbers and popovers to ensure visual parity and preserved hit areas.
acceptance_criteria: All compact control rows keyboard-traverse in a predictable linear order with visible focus styles at 2px contrast delta and focus target >= 44x44px (or clear affordance if visually smaller)
High-contrast tile variant passes WCAG 2.1 AA for normal text and UI components; tokens documented and mapped to light/dark/high-contrast palettes
Numeric formatting respects user locale preference and console-level setting; short notation (K/M) localized — tests for en-US, fr-FR, de-DE, hi-IN, ar-SA, he-IL
RTL flows flip scrubber drag direction and maintain keyboard increment/decrement semantics; no clipped labels in common edge cases
Reduced-motion preference disables non-essential sparkline animation and replaces with static fallback without layout shift
Prototype reviewed and signed off by PM and Eng with linked implementation ticket and QA checklist; accessibility checklist items added to release definition
comments: 2026-03-03 — Initial audit completed across Cost Explorer and Rollouts panels. Found 8 focusable controls with no visible focus at compact density; color token contrast dips below AA at 12px labels in dark theme.

2026-03-04 — Prototype 1 (Figma) created: introduces 2 focus ring options (thick outline + inset shadow) and a compact hit-area shim that keeps visual density but increases interactive target — shared with ENG for feasibility.
2026-03-05 — ENG feedback (Liam O'Connor): inset shim OK but increases DOM size; prefer CSS pseudo-element approach. Added ENG-41012 as dependency for runtime focus shim polyfill.
2026-03-06 — PM review (Ethan Park): confirmed customer impact medium; requested i18n samples for hi-IN and fr-FR; added localized examples to prototype.

2026-03-08 — Accessibility review (external auditor): recommended increasing contrast on secondary stat text and using non-color affordances for state (underline/indicator) for users with color deficiencies.
2026-03-09 — Updated prototype to include high-contrast token set and an accessibility panel in the prototype to toggle reduced-motion, high-contrast, and RTL for testing.
2026-03-10 — Ready for design sign-off. Next: ship implementation PR (ENG-41012), include automated axe-core regression tests, and add QA steps for locale screenshots in the release checklist.
